label: Uneasy calm
summary: The US carried out what officials called 'defensive' strikes in the Strait of Hormuz, with explosions reported on Iran's Qeshm Island, even as Vance cited progress in talks and Tehran said the ball was in Washington's court. A Russian strike on a Ukrainian aid hub killed 26 as the US announced new peace talks. Israeli fire killed four in Gaza, and drones again hit Sudan's power grid. Americans vote in Tuesday's midterms. Australia's central bank raised rates to 4.85 percent, Bangladeshi garment workers said wages leave them hungry, and India braced for a second cyclone in a week. DR Congo's Ebola toll passed 5,300. Brighter notes: more than 750 Ukrainian civilians were evacuated under a truce, right whales returned to Florida waters, and researchers reported an Alzheimer's drug that repairs DNA damage. The weighted formula gave 42; no editorial adjustment.
